name: Message
summary: Whisper a message to a creature within 120 feet that only it hears; it can whisper back to you.
text: Point at a creature within range and whisper a message. Only that creature hears it, and it can whisper a reply that only you hear. You can cast the spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, metal or wood, or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
